Commentary.Commentary: That's it then from this game. The series has only begun but it is Ireland who have taken a 1-0 lead over Afghanistan in the five-match T20I series. The visitors will look to bounce back and level the series or else they will be left with too much to do. The hosts though will look to increase their lead and get one step closer to a series win. The 2nd T20I will be played on the 11th of August and it will begin at 8 pm IST (2.30 pm GMT). Our build-up though will begin much sooner. Till then, take care and goodbye!

The captain of Afghanistan, Mohammad Nabi says that they haven't played a game together for more than a month. Adds that it was a good game and they were short 15-20 runs but Ireland played really well. Says that Usman Ghani played really well and he has been doing really well domestically. Mentions that they have some work to do with their lines and lengths in the Powerplay and towards the end.

Andy Balbirnie (51 runs off 38 balls), the Irish skipper is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his brilliant innings. He says that to get a win is great and they have played well against top teams and it is good to get over the finish line finally. He says that he worked hard and tried to play his game. He ends by saying it was good to get some runs and he will look to continue this form. Balbirnie then comes back on to chat as the skipper of the winning side and says that they are absolutely thrilled by the victory. He says that they bowled pretty well and the batters also did well and chased down the target with wickets in hand. He adds that it is important to use the Powerplay and they did that against a very good bowling attack. He says that everyone sticked to their roles and performed them perfectly.
The Presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the day, after electing to bat, Afghanistan put up a decent score on the board courtesy Usman Ghani at the top and Ibrahim Zadran down the order. That though was chased down as Ireland put in a combined batting effort.

Afghanistan will be disappointed. Their bowling is what they thrive on and that is what let them down. The 5th bowler is what proved to be expensive for them. The likes of Mohammad Nabi and Azmatullah Omarzai went for runs. Naveen-ul-Haq too had a day to forget even after starting off with a maiden. One wonders, why was Mujeeb Ur Rahman not given his full quota. That was quite surprising.

The openers provided the start for Ireland, they added 50 and that too in the Powerplay itself. However, the stand that took away the game from the visitors was the one between Lorcan Tucker and Andy Balbirnie! Both played the sweep shot really well and managed to score a boundary almost every over. They added over 60 runs with both scoring fifties. That turned the tide in the favor of the hosts completely. Afghanistan did make a comeback though by bowling a few tight overs but in the end, it was Harry Tector and George Dockrell who played brilliantly and took their side over the line.

What a win! What a win for Ireland! They have ended their losing streak and in some style! Trust me, this was not an easy target to chase. We felt that Afghanistan got 15 runs more but Ireland have gunned it down really well.

FOUR! That's it, George Dockrell finishes things off in style and Ireland have won the game with just one ball remaining! Banged in short and over middle, Dockrell gets on top of the bounce and pulls it well in front of mid-wicket to find the fence. Ireland win by 7 wickets!

FOUR! Oh, no! It is a brilliant effort in the deep but it has gone for a boundary. Another slower delivery, fuller and on off. George Dockrell punches it back past the bowler and the fielder from long on runs to his left to dive it and cut it off. The momentum though was such that the fielder ended up parrying the ball into the ropes. Just 2 needed now off 2 deliveries.
What a cracking delivery from Naveen-ul-Haq! Nails the toe-crushing yorker and Tector somehow manages to get a bat on it. The ball rolls towards square leg as the batters sneak in a single.

FOUR! The game keeps on swinging like a pendulum. Slower ball, on a length and outside off. Harry Tector picks it up and holds his shape before crunching it over extra cover for a boundary. 7 needed now off 4 balls.

Naveen-ul-Haq seems to be struggling a bit. On the other side, Harry Tector is also seen in some discomfort. The physios are in to check and provide the required treatment. Both of them looks fine now and we are ready to continue.

Well bowled and well ran in the end as well. This is on a hard length and angling into the body. Harry Tector mistimes the pull shot in front of mid-wicket and races back for two. Tector dives in and seems to have hurt himself a bit here.
Naveen-ul-Haq will bowl the last over. It is a nail biting finish. Can he defend 12 runs?

A brilliant comeback in the over from Fazalhaq Farooqi! It's the yorker again, outside off and Harry Tector heaves it off the inner half of the bat towards wide long on for a single. 13 needed now off the final 6 deliveries.
Pitches it up now, a bit in the slot and on off stump, Dockrell drills it down to long off for one. Dockrell will be disappointed that he didn't do more with that one.
Excellent from Farooqi! Nails the wide yorker and George Dockrell gets beaten on the inside edge as he looks to squeeze it out.
Pce on this time, full and wide, Tector drives it firmly towards deep cover for just a single.

SIX! Probably a game-changing blow from Harry Tector! This is another slower ball, dug into the pitch and over middle and leg. Tector picks it up and pulls it a long way in front of mid-wicket for a huge hit. The ball is lost as well. 16 needed now off 10 balls.
Starts off with a length ball, slower in pace and around off. Dockrell plays it on the up and towards long off for a single.
George Dockrell is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Fifty and out for Lorcan Tucker. This is full and around off, in the slot as well, Lorcan Tucker moves across and slog-sweeps it towards the deep mid wicket fence. As it is the longer side, the ball goes high in the air but does not go the distance. Rashid Khan there settles under it and takes a nice catch. 23 runs needed in 12 balls now. We are in for a thrilling finish.
A low full toss and on middle, Harry Tector moves across and tucks it straight to short fine leg for one. He is dissappointed with himself as it was there to be put away.
Two more. This is in the blockhole and on middle and leg, Harry Tector digs it out well through mid-wicket and adds two more to the total.
Good running there. This is on a hard length and on leg, slower too, Harry Tector makes room and whips it of his bottom edge toward deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Fifty for Lorcan Tucker. This has been a great innigs under pressure. This is a bit full and on off, Lorcan Tucker moves across and sweeps it towards short fine leg for a single.
FOUR! DEFT TOUCH! This is on a length and outside off, Lorcan Tucker opens the face of his bat and guides it just past the keeper and towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Another change in the bowling as Naveen-ul-Haq comes on to bowl.
Ends the over brilliantly! 33 needed in 18! A yorker outside off, it is jammed out towards cover for one.
Two! A low full toss outside off, this is jammed through covers for two.
Harry Tector looks to be innovative! Moves right across, this is a slower one outside off. Tector swings again but misses. It hits the body and rolls on the off side. A leg bye taken.
Just another one! Outstanding. A yorker outside off, it is jammed towards cover for one.
Just the one this time! Full and on off, a slower one. It is hit straight to long off for one.
Two! 39 needed in 23. Length and on off, this is hit down to long off for two.
Fazalhaq Farooqi (2-0-15-0) is back on.
BEATEN! This is quicker and flatter, around off, Lorcan Tucker looks to cut it away but misses.
Rashid pushes this wider and Tucker can only manage to tap it towards point.
On the pads again, this is just nudged away towards square leg.
WIDE! This is spilled down the leg side, Tucker misses the sweep and a wide is called.
Good running! This is quicker and flatter, turning into the pads, Lorcan Tucker goes back in his crease and works it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Tossed up a bit, around off and it is the googly. Tector lofts it down towards long off for a single.
A flatter delivery, around off, Harry Tector gets squared out and edges it out towards cover-point.
Rashid Khan is back on for his final over.
A single to end a brilliant over from Mujeeb! He has got his team back in the game! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Harry Tector walks in at number 4 for Ireland.

OUT! TAKEN! There is the breakthrough Afghanistan were so desperate for! The skipper, Andy Balbirnie has to depart and the stand which was taking the game away has been broken. 46 needed in 31. This is on middle, Andy Balbirnie brings out the slog sweep, it is to the longer side and the fielder in the deep takes a well-judged catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Najibullah Zadran b Mujeeb Ur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: Yet another dot! That was stopped well! Fuller and on off, this is driven hard but to covers.
Tosses it up outside off, Andy Balbirnie looks to sweep but it goes off the toe-end towards short third man.
A yorker outside off, it is jammed out towards cover for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is played through point for one.
On middle, this is flicked through mid-wicket for one. Fifty for Andy Balbirnie, a solid knock but he would love to take his side over the line.
More dots needed! On middle, this is worked towards the right of the bowler.
Two more! Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point for two.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Make that two in a row now! On middle, this is swept behind square on the leg side for another boundary. Difficult to see Afghanistan get back into this game now.
FOUR! A boundary to begin the over and Ireland marching along nicely! On middle, this is hit down the ground, straight and into the fence.
Mohammad Nabi (2-0-15-1) brings himself back on.
Another run to end! The runs continue to flow for Afghanistan! On middle, this is swept towards deep square leg for one.
A single now as this is pushed towards cover. Good sensible batting!
FOUR! Nice and fine! Yet another boundary in this over! On the pads, Andy Balbirnie plays it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one more.
On middle, this is nudged through the leg side for another single.
Just the one! A full toss on middle, this is played through square leg for one.
Rashid Khan is back into the attack. Can he be the man to provide the breakhtrough for Afghanistan?
Shorter and outside off, this is guided to point. A dot to end but a productive over for the hosts.
On the pads, this is worked towards short fine leg for one.
FOUR! A boundary is being found every over! On middle, the sweep is out, it is hit towards deep squre leg for a boundary. Afghainstan under huge pressure now.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Misfield and two more! Shorter and outside off, Andy Balbirnie cuts it through point. The fielder in the deep fumbles, two taken.
Shorter and around off, this is guided to point.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman is brought back into the attack.
SIX! Bang! The last ball spoils the over completely! This is a full toss on middle, it is heaved over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Ireland's game to lose now. 77 in 54.
A slower one, well outside off, Tucker slashes at it but misses.
FOUR! Really clever from Tucker! He moves right across, this is on a length and outside off, he manages to paddle it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off, bowling to his field, this is cut to deep point for one.
Tucker steps out and this is bowled wide outside off, it is slapped through covers for one.
A dot to begin after the break! Afhganistan need more dots to build pressure! On middle, this is played back to the bowler.

Drinks! This has been a really good session for Ireland. Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie both scored at a good rate but Stirling got out cheaply. But that did not effect Balbirnie as he looks in good touch. Afghanistan needs a wicket now to get back into this game. Let's see how things pans out. Also, Azmatullah Omarzai is back into the attack for Afghanistan.
Goes full again and on off, Lorcan Tucker flicks it to wide of long on for one and keeps the strike.
Tossed up full and on middle, Andy Balbirnie sweeps it again towards deep mid wicket for one.
Quicker one and on middle, skids through, Andy Balbirnie works it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Good shot! This is flighted and around off, full too, Andy Balbirnie goes inside out and lofts it over extra cover and picks up a boundary.
Floated full  and on off, Andy Balbirnie moves across and sweeps it wide of deep mid-wicekt for a brace.
BEATEN! This is nicely tossed up and on off, Andy Balbirnie makes room to cut at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Floated and on middle, Lorcan Tucker knocks it to the right of the bowler.
A googly now, on middle, Andy Balbirnie drives it to deep cover for one.
Darts this one full and on leg, Lorcan Tucker flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is tossed up full and down the leg, Lorcan Tucker goes down and sweeps it fine towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Pushed through quicker, full and outside off, Andy Balbirnie pushes it towards deep point for a single.
Floated and around, a bit short, Lorcan Tucker tucks it through mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and darted onto the pads, Lorcan Tucker sweeps it away to deep backward square leg for a single.
Full and wide, driven towards extra cover where the fielder makes a good stop.
Just short! This is quicker and fuller, around off, Tucker looks to play it leg side but gets a leading edge. The ball just evades the diving cover-point fielder and the batters get back for two.

OUT! TAKEN! What an absolute brilliant catch by Fazalhaq Farooqi! Paul Stirling will be kicking himself, it was there to be hit but he holes out. This is shorter from Mohammad Nabi and bowled quite a bit wider as well. Stirling rocks back and looks to play it aerially. Stirling ends up slicing it a bit and the ball goes high towards the cover fence. It seems to be just sailing over but Fazalhaq Farooqi stetches his hands over his shoulders and grabs it with his right hand, keeping his balance in the process. Also, Lorcan Tucker walks out to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: c Fazalhaq Farooqi b Mohammad Nabi

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Just past the man! This is tossed up around off, Paul Stirling pre-meditates the reverse sweep and hits it flat, past the diving fielder at short third man for a boundary.
Loopy delivery to start off with from Nabi, full and on off. Paul Stirling looks to flick it away but gets a leading edge towards short cover.
Mohammad Nabi, the skipper brings himself into the attack now.
A bit fuller and fired in on leg stump, Paul Stirling drives it through wide mid on for a single. Tidy start from Rashid Khan, just the 4 singles off it.
Slows it up a touch and bowls it on off, Stirling just defends it out.
On the pads again and worked past square leg for a single by Balbirnie.
On the shorter side, on middle and leg, Stirling just nudges it through mid-wicket for a run.
Swing and a miss! Around off and it is the googly, Paul Stirling decides to get low and slog it away but he is beaten all ends up.
Starts off with a quicker delivery, full and wide and sliding on. Andy Balbirnie drives it nicely through covers and picks up a single.
Rashid Khan is now into the attack.
A dot to end the over then. This is on a length and on middle, Paul Stirling knocks it towards covers.
Full and around off, Andy Balbirnie drives it through cover-point and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Lovely shot! This is on a good length and on the pads, slower too, Andy Balbirnie helps it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary. That brings up the 50 partnership between these two.
Slower again, on a length and on leg, Paul Stirling nudges it through square leg for a single.
SIX! HUGE! A slower one, full and on middle, in the slot, Paul Stirling picks it up early and lofts it over the long on fence for a biggie.
WIDE! Looses his line a bit as this is bowled full, but way down the leg side. Wided.
Fuller one and around off, Andy Balbirnie drives it towards deep point for one.
Full again and outside off, Paul Stirling swats this one wide of long on for a brace. A good over for Ireland as they get 13 runs from it.
Goes full and on middle and off, dipping too, Paul Stirling looks to work it away to the leg side but gets a slight inside edge onto his pads.
Length delivery and around off, Paul Stirling stays there and tries to pull but mistimes it towards mid on.
The ball has disappeared out of the ground! The fourth umpire is on the pitch with a box full of spare balls. The umpires chose one and we are good to continue.
SIX! This time Paul Stirling connects well and sends it all the way. This is short and on middle, Paul Stirling picks up the length early and smokes it over the deep square leg fence for a biggie.

FOUR! A lucky one but Ireland will take it. This is full and on middle, in the slot, Paul Stirling lofts it just wide of the mid on fielder for a welcome boundary. The fielder there could have done better.
This is on a hard length and around off, Andy Balbirnie punches it towards cover-point for a single.
Azmatullah Omarzai to have a bowl now.

A maiden! Would you believe it? This is pitched up around off, Paul Stirling backs away yet again and only manges to loft it towards the man at extra cover. Top over from Naveen-ul-Haq and Ireland's fast start has become a bit stagnant.
Make that five dots on the trot! Length again, on off, Paul Stirling backs away looking to open up the off side but only manages to cut it straight towards point.
A fourth dot in a row now and this will be frustrating Paul Stirling. Fullish delivery, angling into the pads and a bit slower. Stirling flicks it uppishly towards mid-wicket.
Full and straight, Stirling pushes it back towards the bowler who has taken a blow on one of his fingers while making the stop. Naveen-ul-Haq seems fine though.
This is a bit fuller and wider, Paul Stirling tries to shuffle across and get low to slog it behind square but misses. The ball thuds into the pads and goes nowhere.
Starts off with a length ball, close to the off stump, Stirling just opens the face of the bat and guides it towards short third man. There is an easy single on offer but they don't take it.
Naveen-ul-Haq comes into the attack.
FOUR! Short and punished! This is around the hips, Andy Balbirnie just short-arm jabs it one bounce into the backward square leg fence. This is a strong start for Ireland so far.
Length and on the pads, Paul Stirling just nudges it in front of square leg and races through for the single.
Farooqi takes pace off the ball and serves it around off, Andy Balbirnie has a push at it and gets it to the left of the man at mid off for a quick run.
Much better from Farooqi. This is on a good length and in that channel around off, Balbirnie plays inside the line of the ball.
FOUR! Glorious from the Irish skipper. Full and outside off, Balbirnie crouches a bit and then rises up to drive it on the up and through extra cover for a boundary.
Fullish delivery, on middle and leg, Andy Balbirnie flicks it off the inner half of the bat and behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Flighted full and around middle, Paul Stirling knocks it back to the bowler. 11 runs from the over.

EDGED AND FOUR! This is quicker and short on middle, Paul Stirling makes room and slashes hard at it. The ball goes of the outside edge past the keeper and into the third man fence for a boundary. This is turning out to be an expensive over.
Tossed up full and on middle, Andy Balbirnie goes for the sweep again but this time finds the fielder at deep square leg. A single taken.
Good comeback by Mujeeb. This is slower through the air and on off, Andy Balbirnie looks to cut at it but misses.
SIX! BANG! This is floated full and around off, Andy Balbirnie goes down and slog-sweeps it over the backward square fence for the first maximum of the innings.
Tossed up full and on middle, Andy Balbirnie blocks it out.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman to operate from the opposite end.
On a length and on off, Paul Stirling mistimes it back to the bowler.
Length delivery and on middle, shaping in, Paul Stirling tries to work it to the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but turned down.
WIDE! This is on a length and down the leg, Paul Stirling leaves it alone. Wided.
Full again and on off, Paul Stirling knocks it back towards the bowler.
Full and on middle, Andy Balbirnie tucks it wide of mid on for a single and gets off the mark.
On a length and on middle and off, Paul Stirling pushes it with the outer half towards point for a single. Ireland ​​​​and Paul Stirling are underway.
Starts with a full delivery and on off from over the wicket, Paul Stirling knocks it towards mid off.
